Licences

What you can do with what you buy, by kind of product, in plain words.

Buying a product gets you a licence to use its files, not the copyright in them: that stays with the artist or creator. Which licence applies depends on the kind of product, and every product page says which one it has.

Site template licence

For: Site templates

Use it on any of your own sites on AutoStacc. It isn't yours to share or resell.

You can

  • Install it into any profile or project site you can edit on AutoStacc, as often as you like.
  • Change its words, colours, images and layout to make it your own.

You can't

  • Share it to the community library, give it away or sell it, changed or not.
  • Copy it to another website builder or service.

Sound licence

For: Samples, Sample Packs, Presets

Royalty-free in your own music, including music you sell or stream. The files themselves stay yours alone.

You can

  • Use the sounds and presets in your own tracks, remixes, beats, film or game audio and live sets.
  • Release, sell and stream that music anywhere, with no credit, fees or royalties owed.
  • Change, chop, process and resample them as much as you like.

You can't

  • Share, upload, give away or resell the raw files or presets, changed or not.
  • Put them into another sample pack, preset bank, sound library or product for other producers.
  • Register the raw sounds with a content-ID service as your own.

Remix stem licence

For: Stems

Make remixes and release them, even for money, as long as you credit the original artist.

You can

  • Remix, rework and edit the stems into your own version.
  • Release, sell and stream your remix, credited as a remix of the original by its artist.
  • Play your remix in live and DJ sets.

You can't

  • Release the stems, or the original track, unchanged or nearly unchanged.
  • Share, upload or resell the stems themselves.
  • Present the remix as an official release, or leave out the credit to the original artist.

Music licence

For: Music

For your own listening and your own DJ sets.

You can

  • Listen on any of your own devices, and keep backups.
  • Play the tracks in your own DJ sets and live mixes.

You can't

  • Upload, stream, share or resell the files.
  • Use the tracks in your own releases, videos or ads without the artist's permission.

Visuals licence

For: Visuals, VJ Loops

For your own live shows, streams and screens.

You can

  • Show the visuals in your own live sets, events and streams.
  • Use them as wallpapers and backgrounds on your own devices.

You can't

  • Share, upload or resell the files, changed or not.
  • Put them into another visual pack or product for others.

For every licence

  • The licence is yours personally; it can't be passed on or shared with others.
  • It lasts for good, and stays the one you bought under even if the terms change later.
  • A refunded purchase ends its licence.
  • Want to do something not covered here? Ask first: Email support@autostacc.com.
